acceptance_criteria: cargo build -p stoa-transit succeeds with flate2 available
description:
What: Add flate2 = "1" to crates/transit/Cargo.toml [dependencies].
Algorithm:
1. Open crates/transit/Cargo.toml
2. Add line: flate2 = "1" under [dependencies]
3. Run cargo build -p stoa-transit to verify it resolves
Defensive rules: no other changes; verify no feature flags needed for pure-Rust GzDecoder (miniz_oxide backend is default).
Tests: cargo build -p stoa-transit must succeed.
title: Add flate2 dep to stoa-transit Cargo.toml
